items: 【for Samsung New Upgraded】 An upgraded version for the original Samsung remote（TM2280E, TM2281E, BN59-01391A and BN59-01312A） , featuring a fresh design, lightweight and easy to grip, with brightly colored buttons for easy identification

【Universal for All Samsung TV】Perfectly compatible with Samsung Frame Crystal UHD Neo QLED OLED 4/8K smart TVs. Replacement for Samsung remote TM2280E, TM2281E, BN59-01312A BN59-01312B BN59-01301A BN59-01330A BN59-01385A BN59-01391A BN59-01259E BN59-01329 TM1950 TM2050 TM2095 etc
【Key Features】 ①New upgraded appearance and features/buttons ②Perfect replacement (NO voice function) for Samsung voice remote ③4 popular app buttons for direct access to streaming video channels
【NOTE】 Only for Samsung smart TVs. No voice function. Not compatible with Samsung IR remote control. Hotkeys cannot be used if your TV does not support one-touch start for web-video
【Package Included】Two new upgraded replacement remote controls for BN59-01312A. (Batteries and instructions not included)
